hero.title: Indashyikirwa Ihurira no Kwitaho
hero.subtitle: Little Eden School yiyemeje gutanga uburezi bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru bugafasha umwana gutera imbere mu bumenyi, mu mibanire, no mu marangamutima. Niyandikire mu muryango wacu w'abanyeshuri n'abayobozi.
about.title: Ibyerekeye Ishuri rya Little Eden
about.mission.text: dufasha guha abanyeshuri uburezi buhebuje n'iterambere ry'imico bigatuma bahinduka abenegihugu b'isi bashinzwe n'abayobozi b'ejo hazaza.
about.vision.text: Gutanga abanyamuryango beza kurusha abandi bahagaze neza, bashoboye kurushanwa, bagaragaze ubuyobozi bishingiye ku gufasha abandi mu miryango yabo no ku isi.
about.value.excellence.text: Gukorana ubushake buhuriweho n'ubuziranenge bwo hejuru mu byose dukora
about.value.integrity.text: Kuba inyangamugayo n'imyifatire yubahiriza amahame mu bikorwa byose
about.value.community.text: Guteza imbere umwuka wo gufatanya, kwakira abantu bose, no kubashyigikira
about.value.growth.text: Guhora twigira no kwagura ubumenyi no gutera imbere kuri bose
why.title: Ni Kuki Hitamo Ishuri rya Little Eden
why.subtitle: Tutanga uburezi burimo byose bufasha abanyeshuri kugera ku ntsinzi mu bumenyi, imiterere y'imico, no gukura mu mitekerereze yabo.
why.card.0.title: Abarimu Bafite Impamyabumenyi
why.card.0.text: Abarezi bafite ubunararibonye bashyira imbere intsinzi y'abanyeshuri n'iterambere ryabo ryuzuye
why.card.1.title: Aho Hatekanye
why.card.1.text: Ikigo gifasha kandi gifite umutekano ushingiye kuri gahunda zigezweho n'ubufasha bwita ku muryango w'abana
why.card.2.title: Uko kwiga Gikoresha Ikoranabuhanga
why.card.2.text: Ikoranabuhanga rikorwa mu ishuri kugira ngo abanyeshuri bitegure ubumenyi bw'ikinyejana cya 21
why.card.3.title: Amashuri Agezweho
why.card.3.text: Ibikoresho bihendutse kandi byubakwa ku buryo bwo gushyiraho uburyo bwo kwigira bufatanyije n'ubufatanye
why.card.4.title: Imikino Itanga Icyubahiro
why.card.4.text: Porogaramu yuzuye y'imikino itezimbere impano y'imyidagaduro n'ubufatanye
why.card.5.title: Indangagaciro z'umuco
why.card.5.text: Uburezi bw'imico bushingiye ku kuri, kubahana, no kwitwara neza mu muryango
academics.title: Porogaramu z'Uburezi
academics.subtitle: Porogaramu yacu ishingiye ku bushobozi ituma abanyeshuri babasha gukemura ibibazo no gutekereza ku buryo bwimbitse kuri buri rwego.
academics.program.nursery.description: Ibyumweru byambere byibanda ku kwiga ukoresheje umukino, iterambere ry'imibanire, n'ubumenyi bw'ibanze mu gusoma.
academics.program.primary.description: Porogaramu yuzuye yubaka imusingi ikomeye y'amasomo y'ingenzi n'ubuhanga bw'ubuzima.
academics.curriculum.title: Uko twubaka Uburezi
academics.curriculum.national.title: Uburyo bw'Igihugu
academics.curriculum.national.text: Bushingiye ku bipimo by'igihugu by'u Rwanda, bigatuma ubuziranenge n'uburinganire biboneka mu masomo yose.
academics.curriculum.stem.title: Kwihuza STEM
academics.curriculum.stem.text: Ubumenyi mu bya Siyansi, Ikoranabuhanga, Ubuhanga bw'Igishushanyo (Engineering) na Imibare (Mathematics) bihuzwa mu masomo yose kugira ngo bikorwe mu buryo bufatika.
academics.curriculum.co.title: Ibikorwa byo hanze y'icyumba
academics.curriculum.co.text: Imikino, ubuhanzi, umuziki, ibiganiro n'amakipe/club bituma umunyeshuri yiga no hanze y'amasomo y'icyumba.
stats.title: Umusaruro wacu mu mibare
stats.subtitle: Dufasha imiryango kubaka ejo hashize biciye mu burezi bufite ireme n'ubwitange buhoraho.
facilities.title: Ibikoresho byacu
facilities.subtitle: Inyubako zigezweho zakozwe kugirango zishyigikire kwiga n'iterambere byuzuye.
facilities.library.title: Bibiliotheke
facilities.library.description: Bibiliotheke yateguwe neza ifitanye isano n'imyaka y'abana ishyira imbere imyitwarire yo gusoma n'ubuhanga bwo gushakisha amakuru.
facilities.sciencelab.title: Laboratwari ya Sayansi
facilities.sciencelab.description: Laboratwari igezweho yubatswe kugira ngo ibashe gukora ibigeragezo bya bioloji, chimie na fiziki.
facilities.computerlab.title: Laboratwari ya Mudasobwa
facilities.computerlab.description: Ibikoresho bigezweho bya mudasobwa bya literate za numero no guteza imbere ubuhanga bwa ICT.
facilities.playground.title: Ubutaka bwo Gukiniraho
facilities.playground.description: Ahantu hatekanye kandi hanini ho gukinira hagendeye ku mikino n'uburezi bwo hanze.
facilities.transport.title: Gutwara Abanyeshuri
facilities.transport.description: Serivisi z'ubwikorezi zitekanye kandi zizewe zifite amabisi abereye kandi abashoferi b'abahanga.
facilities.smartclassrooms.title: Amashuri y'Ubwenge
facilities.smartclassrooms.description: Ahantu h'uburezi bukoranye n'ikoranabuhanga rigezweho kugira ngo uburezi bube bwiza.
facilities.feature.safe.title: Aho Hatekanye
facilities.feature.safe.text: Umutekano wa amasaha 24/7 n'abantu bashinzwe abamenyereye bashyira imbere umutekano w'abanyeshuri.
facilities.feature.green.title: Aho heza kandi h'icyatsi
facilities.feature.green.text: Gahunda nziza z'indabyo n'ahantu ho hanze bifasha kuruhuka no gukunda kamere.
facilities.feature.accessible.title: Igishushanyo gishobora gukorwamo na bose
facilities.feature.accessible.text: Ibikoresho bituma buri munyeshuri, uko ameze kose, abona ubufasha bungana.

gallery.subtitle: Reba ubuzima bushimishije n'umuco by'ishuri rya Little Eden mu ifoto zacu.
testimonials.title: Ibitekerezo by'Ababyeyi & Abanyeshuri
testimonials.subtitle: Menya uko umuryango wacu ubona uburambe bwabo muri Little Eden School.
testimonials.t0.text: Ishuri rya Little Eden ryahinduye icyizere cy'umwana wanjye n'uburyo yigera. Abarimu baritabira mu ntsinzi ya buri munyeshuri.
testimonials.t1.text: Uburyo bwo kwiga bukoresha mu buryo bwo hejuru. Umukobwa wanjye yakuze si mu kwiga gusa ahubwo no mu myitwarire n'ubuyobozi.
testimonials.t2.text: Nkunda kuza ku ishuri hano. Abarimu bituma kwiga bishimishije, kandi nabonye inshuti nziza. Ibikoresho ni byiza!
testimonials.t3.text: Ubufatanye hagati y'ishuri n'ababyeyi ni bwiza. Buri gihe menya icyo biri kubera n'uburyo umwana wanjye ateye imbere.
testimonials.cta.title: Witeguye Kujya Muri Umuryango Wacu?
testimonials.cta.text: Impa umwana wawe uburezi bw'indashyikirwa n'iterambere ryuzuye.
footer.about.title: Ishuri rya Little Eden
footer.about.text: Uburezi bw'Indashyikirwa. Kugaburira imitekerereze, kubaka ejo hazaza, no kurema abenegihugu b'isi bashingiye ku nshingano.
